lesson.subtitle: Lesson 7 -- How Much? How Many?
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Julia | Lesson 7 -- How Much? How Many?

listenings.text: You asked how much I spent, so I looked at everything last night. Five weeks, and the total was about seven thousand reais. The flight was more than half of that. And here is where I lost control: the first week. I ate out every single day because I did not know where anything was, and that alone was almost a thousand. After that I bought groceries and cooked, and it dropped to nothing. So my advice, and take it seriously: take a little cash for the first two days, no more, and use a card after that. Everybody tells you to take a lot of cash. You do not need much.

Good afternoon, passengers. A reminder about luggage before you reach the desk. With this ticket you can take one bag in the cabin and one bag to check in, at no extra cost. The checked bag cannot be heavier than twenty-three kilos. If your bag is heavier, or if you have more bags, you pay at the desk, and I have to be honest with you: paying here costs a lot more than paying online. So if you already know you have too much luggage, do it on your phone now, in the queue. Thank you.

matching.title: Match the word to its meaning
defs: the bags you take when you travel
the money you plan to spend
the food you buy for the week
an official paper like a passport
to keep money instead of spending

items.situation: Somebody asks how much your English course costs. Answer without saying the exact number.
Ask me two questions about my trips: one with how much, one with how many.

Explain how you save money every month, and how much.
